facts.fact: The Liberia Land Authority signed a three-year MOU with ALLFORLAND and LTMETRIC to develop the Liberia Land Information System, with pilot activities in Montserrado and Margibi Counties expected within a few months.

systems.tiers: national, pilot in Montserrado and Margibi Counties

facts.fact: The Liberian Investigator reports the Swedish-funded SLSL project manager said the project introduced a Digital Land Administration System at the Liberia Land Authority, alongside the online Customary Land Information Management Tool, at its closing seminar in June 2026.

note: A paper deed form notice; a national land information system is only mentioned as an aim.

facts.fact: The Analyst reports the Liberia Land Authority chairman listed the stabilisation and operationalisation of the Land Administration System (LAS) among achievements under the Swedish-supported SLSL project.
The LLA signed a three-year memorandum on 16 October 2025 with All for Land and Lee Metrics to develop and implement the Liberia Land Information System.

systems.owner: Liberia Land Authority with All for Land and Lee Metrics

facts.fact: A Swedish Lantmateriet mission with the Liberia Land Authority reviewed and sought to improve the connectivity and functionality of the LLA Land Administration System and its Deed Verification and Scanning Modules, under a project strengthening the system.
